candidate.product: Winds — an open-source RSS reader and podcast application

observedRevision.note: No revision was pinned. The licence gate is repository-wide and failed on the repository's own declared licence, so no ref, commit, tree, or archive was fetched.

tagInventory.note: The tag inventory was read before the licence result was acted on. It is retained so a future reviewer can see that pinnable ~3-year-old tags do exist; the candidate nevertheless fails on licence.

evidence.detail: GitHub's licence detection reports BSD-3-Clause for this repository. The packet's admission gate requires MIT at the pinned revision. BSD-3-Clause is a permissive licence but it is not MIT: it adds a non-endorsement clause that MIT does not carry, so it is a different set of obligations and does not satisfy an MIT-only corpus policy.

unknownPreserved: Whether the repository root licence file text matches GitHub's BSD-3-Clause detection was not independently read, because the detection result alone already disqualifies the candidate under an MIT-only gate. If corpus policy is ever widened to permissive-non-MIT licences, this candidate must be re-probed from the licence file itself before any reliance is placed on the detection.
disposition: Terminal under the current MIT-only corpus policy. Re-attemptable only if the policy is widened to accept BSD-3-Clause, which is a product decision outside this unit.
nonclaims: This record establishes no source integrity, dependency closure, framework version, build outcome, browser behaviour, migration feasibility, pilot status, production readiness, certification, or legal approval.
The licence reading is a record of the declared licence observed at probe time, not a legal opinion.
No judgement is made here about the technical quality of the application; it was never reached.
